items.description: South Devon coast from Start Point to Dawlish Warren
items.eaAreaName: Devon, Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly

floodArea.riverOrSea: South Devon Coast

items.message:
High tides on Tuesday may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible 2 hours either side of high tide on Tuesday morning and Tuesday evening.
Areas particularly at risk include Torbay, Teignmouth, Beesands, Torcross, Slapton and Dawlish. 
 
The high tide at Exmouth on Tuesday morning is at 05:53, times of high water will vary along the coast. Forecast total high tide level is 2.26mAOD; 0.26 metres above tide table level. Force 6 southerly winds and offshore wave heights of over 1.4m are forecast over the high tide.
 
The high tide on Tuesday evening is at 18:20. Forecast total high tide level is 2.25mAOD; 0.27 metres above tide table level. Force 5 south easterly winds and offshore wave heights of over 1.8m are forecast.
We are closely monitoring the situation .
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded.  
This message will be updated by 12:00PM on Wednesday 25 November or as the situation changes.

items.message:
Flooding is possible for, Polson Bridge, Horsebridge, Gunnislake, Lifton and Sydenham.

Following heavy rainfall on Sunday river levels remain high and are expected to rise overnight with further heavy rain forecast throughout Tuesday.

Further flooding is therefore possible on Tuesday 24 November.

The following gauges are forecast to reach Flood Alert criteria: Launceston Newport.

Catchments are saturated and river levels have risen in response to prolonged rainfall. Further rainfall is expected overnight on Monday 23 November and throughout Tuesday 24 November. Rivers levels will continue to rise in response and surface water flooding impacts are possible.

Locations most affected will be low lying land and roads near rivers.

We are closely monitoring the situation.

Take care and avoid walking, cycling, or driving through flood water.

This message will be updated by 11:00AM on Tuesday 24 November or sooner if the situation changes.

items.eaAreaName: East Anglia

floodArea.riverOrSea: Bure, Ant, Thurne

items.message: Flooding is possible from 6:00am to 11:00am today, Monday 23rd November. This is due to tide locking, where high tides restrict normal drainage of the river out to sea. We expect to see high water levels around Potter Heigham, Wroxham boat yards and Ferry Road in Horning. Levels can take several hours to peak compared to published tide tables. We are closely monitoring the situation. Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water. This message will be updated by 10am on Tuesday 24th November, or as the situation changes.
